description: Inspect local Tailscale connectivity, node identity, health notices, and the active Serve and Funnel routes. Keys, users, and capability maps are omitted.

host.description: MagicDNS host name the route answers on.

mode.description: `serve` for a tailnet-only route, `funnel` when the same listener is also published to the internet.

path.description: URL path prefix the route serves.

target.description: Local target the route proxies to.

url.description: Full HTTPS URL a device opens to reach the route.

backend_state.description: Backend state reported by the client, `Running` when connected.

dns_name.description: MagicDNS name of this node without the trailing dot.

error.description: Error text when the client could not be queried.

funnel_allowed.description: Whether the tailnet policy allows this node to use Funnel.

health.description: Health notices reported by the client.

installed.description: Whether the Tailscale CLI could be started.

online.description: True when the client is running and this node is online.

routes.description: Active Serve and Funnel routes on this node.

tailscale_ips.description: Tailscale IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of this node.
